test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Ron always __blows his own trumpet__ by mentioning his academic achievements.

options.text: To blow air into an instrument
To talk proudly about one's success
To ignore someone in the presence of others
To save one's money with great effort using different means

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. To talk proudly about one's success. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"blows his own trumpet"** means to talk proudly about one's achievements or successes. (अपनी सफलता के बारे में गर्व से बात करना) • **Example:** He always blows his own trumpet about how he saved the company from bankruptcy. • **"To talk proudly about one's success"** refers to the act of boasting or bragging about one's accomplishments. (अपनी उपलब्धियों के बारे में डींग मारना) • **Example:** She never misses an opportunity to talk proudly about her success in the business world. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. To talk proudly about one's success.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To blow air into an instrument** (एक यंत्र में हवा फूंकना): Physically blowing air into a musical instrument to produce sound. • **Example:** The musician blew air into the trumpet to start the concert. • **To ignore someone in the presence of others** (दूसरों की मौजूदगी में किसी को नजरअंदाज करना): To deliberately not pay attention to someone when others are around. • **Example:** She felt hurt when her friends ignored her in the presence of others. • **To save one's money with great effort using different means** (विभिन्न तरीकों का उपयोग करके बड़ी मेहनत से पैसे बचाना): To save money diligently through various methods. • **Example:** He managed to save a significant amount of money with great effort using different means. 5c:Ta4e, ```html The correct answer is **Option 2**.
